runs.name: tag
runs.command: thinkthen tag 'Which topics does this cover?' billing shipping urgent praise < message.txt
runs.input:
You charged me twice and the package still has not shipped.
I need this fixed today.
runs.see: The message gets billing, shipping, and urgent, and praise stays off.

runs.name: tag-answer
runs.command: thinkthen tag --details 'Which topics does this cover?' billing shipping urgent praise < message.txt | jq '.answer.probabilities'
runs.input:
You charged me twice and the package still has not shipped.
I need this fixed today.
runs.see: Each of the three topics clears 0.9, and praise sits at 0.01.
